_comment: Machine-readable source config. Human-readable mirror: deals/_config/parish-sources.md
_prohibited_hosts_note: Blocked in code by assert_host_permitted(), which raises before any request. Each entry expressly restricts automated collection in its own robots.txt or terms. Removing an entry is a legal decision, not a technical one.

jefferson.name: Jefferson Parish
jefferson.disabled_reason: No permitted scrapable source exists. Tax-delinquency and adjudicated data must come via public records request - see docs/JEFFERSON-RECORDS-REQUEST.md. Do not improvise a source.

candidate_sources.label: CivicSource tax sale / adjudicated property auctions
candidate_sources.robots_detail: robots.txt has zero Disallow directives, but the Terms of Use prohibit monitoring 'through the use of a robot, spider, or other similar device or method'. The ToS governs. Initial 'go' verdict was corrected same-day.
candidate_sources.tos_quote: you will not copy, modify, sell, distribute, reverse engineer, or monitor (through the use of a robot, spider, or other similar device or method) any portion of the Website or any information contained on the Website
candidate_sources.note: DO NOT BUILD AGAINST THIS. A scheduled sweep is robot monitoring, which is the named prohibited activity. An empty robots.txt is not permission.

candidate_sources.label: Jefferson Parish Clerk of Court
candidate_sources.robots_detail: Disallow /wp-admin/ only; Crawl-delay: 10 published by the operator
candidate_sources.note: Crawl-delay 10 is the site operator's stated limit and overrides the global 1 req/s default.

candidate_sources.label: Jefferson Parish Assessor
candidate_sources.robots_detail: robots.txt contains Cloudflare content-signal boilerplate as comments only; no signal set. Per the file's own paragraph (c) this neither grants nor restricts.
candidate_sources.note: Go with restraint, not go without limit. Absent signal is not affirmative permission - low volume, honest UA, stop on any block.

candidate_sources.label: Jefferson Parish government
candidate_sources.robots_detail: Content paths permitted; /admin, /search.asp*, /search.aspx* disallowed. jeffparish.net redirects here - use the .gov host.

candidate_sources.label: Jefferson Parish Sheriff (tax collector)
candidate_sources.robots_detail: Host did not respond during recon (2026-08-17) from this network; may be filtering rather than an outage. Verify by phone before assuming it is down.
candidate_sources.note: The Sheriff is the tax collector in Louisiana parishes, so the delinquent tax roll most likely lives here. Primary target of the public records request.

candidate_sources.label: Jefferson Parish public records portal (NextRequest)
candidate_sources.robots_detail: Government records intake portal behind bot protection. Submit through a browser; never automate. This is a request channel, not a data source.
candidate_sources.note: RECOMMENDED ROUTE. No ToS conflict, returns bulk CSV rather than paginated HTML, and produces an auditable provenance document. See docs/JEFFERSON-RECORDS-REQUEST.md.
